headline: Shipping Delays as JK Tyre & Industries Ltd. Faces Email Breach, Affects Partners
body: JK Tyre & Industries Ltd., renowned in the automotive industry, encountered a business email compromise disrupting some of their order and shipment communications. The company emphasized that no plant systems were encrypted, keeping production lines operational. Minimal logistics delays are anticipated. Fellow suppliers Denso International America, Inc. and Keeper Co., Ltd. also reported similar though limited disruptions in their administrative IT processes.
